purpose: Prepare RXC as the third receiver for final three-receiver manifest-bound replay experiments.
compatibility: Receiver logger remains compatible because packet rows are unchanged.
Parser remains compatible because payload format is unchanged.
RXC identity is represented by the sketch banner and raw log filename, not by changing the packet row.
interpretation_boundary: RXC adds a third receiver-side observation stream.
RXB and RXC are not calibrated identical instruments.
Receiver-specific packet identities are descriptive receiver-side evidence only.
